mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint rise in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market supporting strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0 for three consecutive months, robust manufacturing activity signals economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime, sustained housing starts (HOUST) above 1200.0 thousand units signals strong residential investment that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.0 during housing market boom, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% signal restrictive monetary policy that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling windows.
